bra: Every product fact is the page's and verified live (read live from the product page 2026-09-24): 100 cm, 335 g, 25 cm, `var tionde sekund`, `Ryggen värker innan halva bilen är tvättad` (the page's own headline), stainless steel, grey microfibre.
The reach limitation is stated honestly in four briefs (sides, bonnet and boot — not an SUV roof) and the ban on `halkfri`, `reptålig`, `skonar lacken` is in every Rules block.
BOF_2_1 reads the store terms right — only the statutory 14-day right of withdrawal, no invented guarantee, no Klarna mark — the finding from the 2026-09-21 review landed in a brand-new hub.
Reviews verified live and dated, quoted verbatim, no aggregate line; PD_3_H1/PD_3_H2 hold the body identical and change only the hook.
Store name never appears; no policy lines; price 799 / 1 039 / 240 kr right in all 17.
missat: BOF_3_1 opens on a question (`100 cm – räcker den till taket?`) — a question cannot be true or false; the answer is already in the sub-line and should be the headline. Still in To be Reviewed, so it can be fixed before upload.

Body lines are shared across concepts: `Armen orkar hela tvätten – borsten väger 335 gram.` in 7 of 17 briefs, `100 cm teleskopskaft i rostfritt stål.` in 8 — when the same line sits in seven concepts, the data cannot say which idea sold.

The round contradicts itself: RV_1_1 quotes a customer saying the pole reaches `överallt` while four sibling briefs say it does not reach an SUV roof. Both are true for the people saying them, but side by side in one feed they read as a contradiction — pair the quote with the reach line or use Erik's quote only.
PD_3_H1 calls its parent `the account's current winner` without naming it or giving CPA, purchases or break-even; CS_3_H1 shows price cards for 11 seconds before any demo.

No VARIABELTAGGAR, no Memo, no `AI content:` line, no COPY CARD and no shot-level direction table — the brief format since 2026-09-21 (docs/os/BRIEF-REGI.md, `CS-KLART` 2.9/2.12); written 2026-09-19/20 so the direction table is a note, not an error, this once.
This product has no memory in the repo — the Feedback row in the hub is its memory.
regler: Hooks are declaratives: the answer is the headline (`100 cm räcker till sidorna och motorhuven. Inte SUV-taket.` is already written in BOF_2_1) — never `räcker den till taket?`.
A body line belongs to one concept: `335 gram` is TR_1_1's claim, `100 cm rostfritt stål` is LI_1_1's — the other concepts get their own proof line, or the next /cs cannot tell which idea sold.
Every brief carries the 2026-09-21 format (VARIABELTAGGAR, Memo, AI content, direction table), and a Why that says "winner" names the ad with CPA, purchases and break-even.

Inte taket på en SUV.`) and drop the question.
